headline: Result Update

highlights: Important Data • Strong quarter all round: Revenue grew 13%, driven by 10% volume growth in India and 13% constant currency growth in international.

EBITDA rose 27% and profit after tax 31%, the fastest profit growth in 50 quarters. • Gross margin up about 600 bps YoY: Three things drove it: o a better product mix; o higher profits from the new growth businesses; o cheaper copra. • Ad spend up 44%: The extra spend went into building the core brands for the long term and scaling up the new businesses faster.
Even so, EBITDA margin widened 200 bps to 18.2%. • Two-year view: Revenue grew 22% a year and EBITDA 17% a year over two years.
This was supported by 8% volume growth in India and 16% constant currency growth in international.
valuation: At ₹898, the stock trades at about 47x FY28E EPS of ₹19.1, which is a premium valuation and already reflects the improved growth outlook, margin tailwinds, and management’s higher medium-term ambitions.
It has also pulled forward its ₹20,000crs revenue target from FY30 to FY29, implying 13–14% annual revenue growth without acquisitions.

While these targets are achievable if current momentum continues, the market is likely to have already priced in a substantial portion of this optimism after the strong quarterly results and the subsequent rally in the stock.
watch: Strong execution, new launches and market share gains in key categories drove growth. • South Africa (+15% CC): Growth sped up, led by hair care.

Consumer inflation rose, led by food, edible oil and fuel. • Management said this makes it important to stay quick on pricing, sourcing and execution. • Marico sees protein as a big bet and is going after it hard through four brands: Saffola, Cosmix, Plix and True Elements H1 FY27 and outlook: • Strong first half: Revenue grew 18%, EBITDA 26% and profit after tax 28%.
